description: Initial structured handwriting capture template for consent-based glyph extraction.

provenance_notice.title: Consent-Based Handwriting Capture
provenance_notice.body: Use only your own handwriting or handwriting from someone who has explicitly consented. Generated outputs should include provenance.

notes: V1 starts with lowercase letters only so the template fits on one page.
Uppercase letters, digits, and punctuation are planned extensions.
